# DataRobot

> DataRobot is an enterprise AI platform providing agentic AI apps, workflow automation, and AI governance for Fortune 500 companies across finance, healthcare, supply chain, and government sectors.

DataRobot's unified Agent Workforce Platform enables organizations to build, deploy, and govern AI solutions at scale. The platform integrates with major enterprise systems like SAP and leverages GPU acceleration through partnerships with NVIDIA, Dell, and Nebius for high-performance AI deployment.

## Key Topics

- Agent Workforce Platform
- Agentic AI Apps
- Enterprise AI Suite
- AI Governance
- Generative AI
- LLMs
- GPU Acceleration
- Predictive Analytics
- AI Deployment
- Machine Learning
- Financial Services AI
- Supply Chain AI
- Healthcare AI
- NVIDIA Integration
- SAP Integration

## Industry Solutions

- [Financial Services](https://www.datarobot.com/solutions/financial-services): AI solutions for financial services including fraud detection, credit risk, and compliance.
- [Finance AI App Suite](https://www.datarobot.com/solutions/finance): Finance AI App Suite for forecasting, budgeting, and risk management in financial services.
- [Supply Chain & Operations](https://www.datarobot.com/solutions/supply-chain-operations): Supply Chain & Ops AI App Suite for demand forecasting and inventory management.
- [Healthcare](https://www.datarobot.com/solutions/healthcare): Healthcare AI solutions for clinical applications, pharma development, and provider/payer solutions.
- [Manufacturing](https://www.datarobot.com/solutions/manufacturing): AI solutions for manufacturing including predictive analytics and production optimization.
- [Oil and Gas](https://www.datarobot.com/solutions/oil-and-gas): Agentic AI solutions for upstream, midstream, and downstream oil and gas operations.
- [Government Agencies](https://www.datarobot.com/solutions/ai-for-government-agencies): Mission-critical AI solutions for U.S. government agencies with secure deployment.

## Strategic Partnerships

- [DataRobot and NVIDIA](https://www.datarobot.com/solutions/partners/nvidia): DataRobot and NVIDIA partnership for Agent Workforce Platform with GPU acceleration.
- [DataRobot and SAP](https://www.datarobot.com/solutions/partners/sap): DataRobot and SAP integration for pre-built AI apps in SAP HANA and S/4 HANA.
- [DataRobot and Dell AI Factory](https://www.datarobot.com/solutions/partners/dell): DataRobot, Dell, and NVIDIA validated AI factory for agent workforce deployment.
- [DataRobot and Nebius](https://www.datarobot.com/solutions/partners/nebius): DataRobot and Nebius enterprise AI cloud for agents with NVIDIA GPU infrastructure.
